purpose: Every document in docs/research/ is classified by its epistemic tier so a reviewer can tell load-bearing research from exploratory speculation without reading all of it. tests/unit/repo-hygiene/researchIndex.test.ts fails if any file here is unclassified or any classified file is missing, so this index cannot silently drift.

tiers.core: Load-bearing for the thesis in 00_THESIS.md. Every claim maps to a runnable command or a checked-in artifact. A reviewer should read these.
tiers.supporting: Grounded protocol, contract, or mechanism documents that a core claim depends on. Specific and checkable, but not themselves the contribution.
tiers.exploratory: Speculative or theoretical drafts. NOT evidence for any claim. Retained for design provenance. May contain framing that the implementation does not support.
tiers.process: Audit trails, roadmaps, rebuttals, and working notes. Historical record of how the work proceeded, not claims about the system.
tiers.non-research: Business, market, or commercial material. Present in the repository for convenience; carries no research weight and should not be read as a finding.
